input.body:
Hello Priya,

Thanks for getting in touch about a GenAI workshop for your operations managers. We run hands-on AI corporate workshops, and we would be glad to help your team of about 40 in Pune in the week of 17 Nov.

Given Acme Logistics' work across western India, and the new cold-chain hub in Nagpur, we see useful practical ground in areas like route planning with AI and demand forecasting. We can tailor the session to the problems your operations managers face day to day.

Could we have a 20-minute call this week to talk through your goals and what the week of 17 Nov. could look like?

Best regards,
Ann Rao

smallTech provides AI training and AI services for small and mid-sized teams. We can help shape a workshop around the day-to-day work your operations managers do, so the session is practical rather than abstract. I would be happy to talk through what you have in mind, including the goals, the format and the timing.

Would you have 15 minutes for a short call this week or next? If it is easier, reply with a couple of times that suit you and I will work around them.

Best regards,
Bob Das
